title: Beyond the LC25000 ceiling: optimizer robustness and external validity of a convolutional network and a vision transformer for lung cancer histopathology classification
description: Official v2.0.0 replication package containing training and evaluation code, split manifests (image-level, rotation-invariant group-aware, and LungHist700 patient-grouped), all 16 YAML configuration files (S1-S14 + G1-G2), per-epoch logs, per-fold metrics, statistical tests, and publication figure scripts for comparative benchmarking of ResNet50 and ViT-S/16 on LC25000 and LungHist700 histopathology datasets.
